description: Returns a company-level Payment Term by id. Requires company payments read permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the payment term. This is the same value returned as payment_terms_id on commitment contracts.

data.description: Company-level payment term definition. Commitments reference this resource via payment_terms_id. The same term may be snapshotted onto invoices as an Invoice Payment Term.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the payment term. Matches payment_terms_id on commitment contracts.

company_id.description: Company ID that owns this payment term

name.description: Display name of the payment term

net_days.description: Number of days after the qualifying event that payment is due

discount_valid_days.description: Number of days the discount remains valid after invoice submission

discount_due_day_of_month.description: Day of the month the discount expires, for DISCOUNT_TERMS payment terms

auto_expire_discount.description: Whether the discount automatically expires once the due date passes

erp_id.description: External ERP system identifier for this payment term, when configured

active.description: Whether the payment term is currently active and available for assignment

created_at.description: Timestamp when the payment term was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the payment term was last updated
